title: Ptah Builders — membership launch (vertical short cut)

slides.vo: You have finished the tutorials. You still have not shipped the product.
Ptah Builders is a cohort. Six to eight weeks, and at the end you have a real product running in production.
Every week has one job. Foundation, domain, authentication, billing, agents, hardening, deploy, launch. You build live, and your work is reviewed before it ships.
Weekly live sessions, a private room for members, and cohorts running in English and in Arabic side by side.
It lists at twenty nine dollars a month, or two hundred and ninety a year — but approved early adopters get their first year free. No card, now or later. Seats are limited. Apply for the next cohort.
captions: Lists at 29 a month, 290 a year
